title: For Agents, By Agents: Building AI Tools That Maintain Themselves
summary: Rudrank Riyam explains how App Store Connect CLI turns production incidents into instructions, skills, tests, issue triage, pull-request repair, and release automation that later agents can reuse. He also shares command-error telemetry, untrusted-contribution checks, isolated credentials, and the point where major releases and final iOS polish return to a human.
takeaway: Let failures improve the toolchain: capture each recurring error as a test or skill, verify external changes independently, and retain human approval for major releases and final product judgment.
